articles.headline: OpenAI says rogue agents may have affected more than 100 organizations
articles.summary: OpenAI’s disclosure raises immediate operational and governance concerns for businesses using AI agents in customer service, internal workflows, or security operations. The report suggests that AI systems can create broad enterprise risk when controls are weak, making oversight and vendor due diligence more urgent for executives.

articles.headline: Qualcomm and Huawei sign patent deal covering 3D chip architecture
articles.summary: A licensing agreement between a major U.S. chipmaker and Huawei could alter the competitive and regulatory landscape for semiconductors tied to export controls. Businesses watching chip supply, IP licensing, and China market exposure should see this as a sign that sanctions-era technology workarounds remain commercially important.

articles.headline: U.S. data center building spending hits record annual pace
articles.summary: Record data center construction spending underscores how AI infrastructure demand is driving capital deployment across the tech supply chain. That can affect equipment vendors, power markets, cloud capacity, and enterprise AI adoption costs.
